# Overview
## Objective
+ Calculate agricultural water-provisioning GEP using the commercial-agriculture GEP prepared in `4-1-prep-commercial-GEP.qmd`.
+ Match commercial GEP and the water-contribution coefficients by country and CropGBWater crop.
+ Calculate green-water GEP on rainfed and irrigated land and blue-water GEP on irrigated land.
+ Report every country in `z_ee_r250`, with a reason when its GEP is missing.

## Data
+ `commercial_gep_rainfed_irrigated_CropGBWater_2020.csv`: Commercial GEP split between rainfed and irrigated production, in `Data/Processed/`.
+ `lambda_jr_tbl_CropGBWater.csv`: Crop-country water-contribution coefficients, in `Data/Processed/`.
+ `z_ee_r250_correspondence.gpkg`: Country identifiers and names, in `Data/Raw/boundary/`.

Commercial GEP is already the monetary base, so the GPV adjustment factor `theta` is not applied again. A component with zero commercial GEP is zero even if its lambda is missing. A positive component with a missing lambda stays missing. Country totals sum crop-country values for which all three components can be calculated.
The country report retains the full boundary country list. Missing country GEP values remain missing and receive a reason in `missing_reason`.

The commercial GEP input is in current 2020 US dollars. Monetary values are converted to 2019 US dollars using the annual-average U.S. CPI-U (2019: 255.657; 2020: 258.811), from the [U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://www.bls.gov/regions/mid-atlantic/data/consumerpriceindexannualandsemiannual_table.htm).

# Data preparation

## Load data

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# /*===========================================*/
#'=  Commercial agriculture GEP =
# /*===========================================*/
commercial_gep_jr <-
  fread(
    here("Data/Processed/commercial_gep_rainfed_irrigated_CropGBWater_2020.csv")
  )

# /*===========================================*/
#'=  Lambda table =
# /*===========================================*/
lambda_jr_tbl <-
  fread(
    here("Data/Processed/lambda_jr_tbl_CropGBWater.csv")
  ) %>%
  .[
    , .(
      iso3, CropGBWater_crop, crop_name,
      lambda_gn_rf, lambda_gn_ir, lambda_bl_ir,
      lambda_total_ir, lambda_gn_rf_vmr, lambda_gn_ir_vmr
    )
  ]

# /*===========================================*/
#'=  Country identifiers =
# /*===========================================*/
z_ee_r250 <-
  st_read(
    here("Data/Raw/boundary/z_ee_r250_correspondence.gpkg"),
    quiet = TRUE
  ) %>%
  as.data.table() %>%
  .[, .(iso3_r250_id, iso3_r250_name, iso3_r250_label)] %>%
  unique()
```

## Merge commercial GEP and lambda

```{r}
commercial_gep_lambda_jr <-
  merge(
    commercial_gep_jr,
    lambda_jr_tbl,
    by = c("iso3", "CropGBWater_crop"),
    all.x = TRUE
  ) %>%
  merge(
    z_ee_r250,
    by.x = "iso3",
    by.y = "iso3_r250_label",
    all.x = TRUE
  )
```

# GEP calculation

## Crop-country level GEP calculation

```{r}
# === GEP by crop, country, source === #
gep_crop_country_source <-
  copy(commercial_gep_lambda_jr) %>%
  .[
    , `:=`(
      GEP_gn_rf_jr = fifelse(
        commercial_gep_rain_kusd == 0,
        0,
        lambda_gn_rf * commercial_gep_rain_kusd
      ),
      GEP_gn_irr_jr = fifelse(
        commercial_gep_irr_kusd == 0,
        0,
        lambda_gn_ir * commercial_gep_irr_kusd
      ),
      GEP_bl_irr_jr = fifelse(
        commercial_gep_irr_kusd == 0,
        0,
        lambda_bl_ir * commercial_gep_irr_kusd
      ),
      GEP_total_irr_jr = fifelse(
        commercial_gep_irr_kusd == 0,
        0,
        lambda_total_ir * commercial_gep_irr_kusd
      ),
      GEP_gn_rf_vmr_jr = fifelse(
        commercial_gep_rain_kusd == 0,
        0,
        lambda_gn_rf_vmr * commercial_gep_rain_kusd
      ),
      GEP_gn_irr_vmr_jr = fifelse(
        commercial_gep_irr_kusd == 0,
        0,
        lambda_gn_ir_vmr * commercial_gep_irr_kusd
      )
    )
  ]

# === Total GEP by crop and country === #
tg_cols <- c("GEP_gn_rf_jr", "GEP_gn_irr_jr", "GEP_bl_irr_jr")

gep_crop_country_source[
  , GEP_total_jr := fifelse(
    rowSums(!is.na(.SD)) == length(tg_cols),
    rowSums(.SD),
    NA_real_
  ),
  .SDcols = tg_cols
]
```

## Convert to 2019 US dollars

```{r}
cpi_2019 <- 255.657
cpi_2020 <- 258.811
usd_2020_to_2019 <- cpi_2019 / cpi_2020

monetary_cols <- c(
  "commercial_gep_total_kusd",
  "commercial_gep_rain_kusd",
  "commercial_gep_irr_kusd",
  "GEP_gn_rf_jr",
  "GEP_gn_irr_jr",
  "GEP_bl_irr_jr",
  "GEP_total_irr_jr",
  "GEP_gn_rf_vmr_jr",
  "GEP_gn_irr_vmr_jr",
  "GEP_total_jr"
)

gep_crop_country_source[
  , (monetary_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) x * usd_2020_to_2019),
  .SDcols = monetary_cols
]
gep_crop_country_source[, GEP_unit := "1000 2019 US$"]

# --- Save --- #
fwrite(
  gep_crop_country_source,
  here("Data/Results/gep_agwater_crop_country_source_commercial_base_2019usd.csv")
)
```

## Country-level GEP aggregation

```{r}
sum_if_any <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

gep_crop_country_source[, missing_reason_jr := fcase(
  !is.na(GEP_total_jr), NA_character_,
  is.na(commercial_gep_total_kusd), "No usable commercial GEP value",
  split_status == "missing_SPAM_row", "SPAM production data missing",
  split_status == "zero_SPAM_production", "Zero SPAM production",
  default = "Required lambda missing"
)]

# Aggregate the same crop-country rows in each component and the total.
gep_country_aggregated <-
  gep_crop_country_source[!is.na(iso3_r250_id),
    .(
      GEP_gn_rf = sum_if_any(GEP_gn_rf_jr[!is.na(GEP_total_jr)]),
      GEP_gn_ir = sum_if_any(GEP_gn_irr_jr[!is.na(GEP_total_jr)]),
      GEP_bl_irr = sum_if_any(GEP_bl_irr_jr[!is.na(GEP_total_jr)]),
      GEP_total_irr = sum_if_any(GEP_total_irr_jr[!is.na(GEP_total_jr)]),
      GEP_gn_rf_vmr = sum_if_any(GEP_gn_rf_vmr_jr[!is.na(GEP_total_jr)]),
      GEP_gn_ir_vmr = sum_if_any(GEP_gn_irr_vmr_jr[!is.na(GEP_total_jr)]),
      GEP_total = sum_if_any(GEP_total_jr),
      n_crop = .N,
      n_crop_with_gep = sum(!is.na(GEP_total_jr)),
      missing_reason = if (all(is.na(GEP_total_jr))) {
        paste(sort(unique(na.omit(missing_reason_jr))), collapse = "; ")
      } else NA_character_
    ),
    by = .(iso3_r250_id, iso3_r250_label = iso3, iso3_r250_name, GEP_unit)
  ]

# Keep every country in the boundary correspondence, including those with no
# mapped commercial-agriculture crop record.
gep_country_source <-
  merge(
    z_ee_r250,
    gep_country_aggregated,
    by = c("iso3_r250_id", "iso3_r250_label", "iso3_r250_name"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )

gep_country_source[is.na(n_crop), `:=`(
  n_crop = 0L,
  n_crop_with_gep = 0L,
  missing_reason = "No mapped commercial-agriculture crop record"
)]
gep_country_source[is.na(GEP_unit), GEP_unit := "1000 2019 US$"]

# --- Save --- #
fwrite(
  gep_country_source,
  here("Data/Results/gep_agwater_country_source_commercial_base_2019usd.csv")
)
```

# For report

## Report total GEP by country

```{r}
gep_country_report <-
  gep_country_source[,
    .(
      iso3_r250_id,
      iso3_r250_label,
      iso3_r250_name,
      wateruse_ag_gep = GEP_total * 1000, # Convert from thousand to 2019 US$
      missing_reason
    )
  ]

dir.create(here("Data/Results/Submission"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fwrite(
  gep_country_report,
  here("Data/Results/Submission/wateruse_ag_gep_commercial_base_2019usd.csv")
)
```
